Product:{\"sku\":\"7100095298\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Picture this: A dusty old attic, cobwebs, forgotten boxes and the faint smell of neglect. Four curious kids stumble upon an ancient, tattered map, sparking an unexpected adventure…

Setting out to sea upon their ramshackle boat, a sudden, ferocious storm hurls them into a hidden world brimming with danger and mystery. Now it’s down to you to help them work together and find their way home in Survival Kids - a fast-paced, co-op survival game for absolutely everyone!

Stranded on a series of unique islands, set upon the back of giant Whurtles, work together with up to 4 players online or 2 players in local co-op to explore, chop, craft, fish, cook and solve your way to safety - all whilst surviving everything the islands throw at you!

Master the island's challenges, use the Harmony Stones to tame the storm and make it back home with an epic story to tell!

Better Together!

Crafting, exploring and tools are all designed to work better when you’re together. You might choose to fell a tree alone, but if you and a friend work alongside each other you can bring it down with half the effort! Whether playing with friends and family at home on the couch, or online, the best Survival Kids experience is played together!

Survival Made Simple!

With an intuitive crafting system and no inventory management, there’s no need for complicated menus to manage hundreds of items. Just gather the materials needed for crafting and you're good to go - it’s that simple!

An Island Paradise

Island vistas burst to life with vibrant toon-style visuals, a playful soundtrack and charming sound effects. Paired with simple gameplay mechanics and accessible UI, it’s an experience sure to captivate players of all ages!

New Horizons

Exclusive to the Nintendo Switch™ 2, Survival Kids takes full advantage of the console's unique communication and game-sharing features, enhancing the gameplay experience and boosting the multiplayer fun!
